target: 1979 Toa Payoh Lorong 6 Dragon Playground; coherent 2025 appearance
orientation_convention: Avoid ambiguous front/left/right until model coordinates are solved. Side A means the orange head-face orientation in P01; side B is the opposite orientation in P03/P04. Head-end means snout end; turn-end means the far curved body return. Slides descend toward the body side, so head-end is not called slide-end.
